Item 5.07. Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.
(a)
The 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareowners of The Coca-Cola Company (the “Company”) was held on Wednesday, April 29, 2026. The results of the matters submitted to a vote of the shareowners at the meeting are set forth below. Pursuant to Delaware law and the Company’s By-Laws, abstentions and broker non-votes are not considered votes cast and do not affect the outcome of the votes. Therefore, only votes for and against each matter are included in the percentages below.
